records.name: Mourning Mist
records.description: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.

description.value: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.

tooltip.value: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that deals {{ calc_healthdamage }} max Health magic damage , Slows by {{ calc_slow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds and marks champions and monsters for {{ markduration }} seconds. Marked enemies continuously Awaken nearby graves (but not exceeding the maximum of {{ spell.yorickpassive:yorickpassiveghoulmax }}) and suffer {{ armorshred*100 }}% reduced Armor . Yorick and his summoned units gain {{ hasteamount*100 }}% Move Speed toward the mark. Mist Walkers will leap once at marked enemies that get away from them.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Last Rites
records.description: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

description.value: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

tooltip.value: Yorick's next Attack deals an additional {{ bonusdamage }} physical damage and restores {{ qheal }} plus {{ missinghealthratio }}% of his missing Health , reduced by {{ healreduction }}% against non-Champions. If this Attack hits a Champion or large Monster or kills the target, it leaves a grave. When there are 3 or more graves nearby and this Ability has already been used, Yorick can Recast to raise Mist Walkers from all nearby graves.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Eulogy of the Isles
records.description: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

description.value: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

tooltip.value: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist with {{ yorickbigghoulhealth }} Health and {{ yorickbigghouldamage }} Magic Attack Damage plus {{ rghoulnumbers }} Mist Walkers . The Maiden automatically raises Mist Walkers from nearby enemy deaths and marks enemy Champions with her attacks. When Yorick damages the Maiden's target, he deals {{ rmarkdamagepercent }}% max Health magic damage . After 10 seconds, Yorick can Recast this Ability to free the Maiden , sending her down the nearest lane.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Dark Procession
records.description: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

description.value: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

tooltip.value: Yorick summons a wall of spirits blocking enemies' path, but not allies'. The wall has {{ wallhealthtooltip }} Health and disappears after {{ circleduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Shepherd of Souls
records.description: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

lore.value: The last survivor of a long-forgotten religious order, Yorick is both blessed and cursed with power over the dead. Trapped on the Shadow Isles, his only companions are the rotting corpses and shrieking wraiths that he gathers to him. Yorick's monstrous actions belie his noble purpose: to free his home from the curse of the Ruination.
